description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Al. M. S. Sahabdeen and Mr. C. R. Bandara from the Administrative District of Kurunegala and Mr. Arawgoda Mudiyanselage Dharmasiri Mr. Inok Thushara Rankiri Pathirage and Mr. Warnakulasooriya Jude Suresh Gamani Fernando from the Administrative District of Puttalam as the Members of the North Western Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a Provincial Council due to members being elected to Parliament. It involves the electoral process, including notifications of vacancies, nominations by political parties, and declarations of elected members by the Commissioner of Elections. This falls under election-related matters, specifically addressing electoral procedures and filling elected positions.
